actual.descripcion: Genesis ║ In Chile's Torres del Paine, melt from snow-covered mountains feeds finger-like fjords as they reach out to the sea to join the current, lowering its salinity and becoming home to wading birds, rare dolphins and orcas.

siguiente.descripcion: Journey ║ The Humboldt Current is slower than most ocean currents, but it's the most dynamic in the world because it travels for such a long distance and lays the foundation for an intricate marine food chain.

lista.descripcion: Genesis ║ In Chile's Torres del Paine, melt from snow-covered mountains feeds finger-like fjords as they reach out to the sea to join the current, lowering its salinity and becoming home to wading birds, rare dolphins and orcas.

Journey ║ The Humboldt Current is slower than most ocean currents, but it's the most dynamic in the world because it travels for such a long distance and lays the foundation for an intricate marine food chain.
Arrival ║ The current is followed by a unique population of Chilean blue whales and is the last refuge for other extremely rare marine mammals.
Part 1: Underwater Wonders ║ Today we explore the USS Arizona and the marine environment which formed around it. Later, we journey into the underwater world of Yellowstone National Park.
Part 2: Underwater Wonders ║ Today we dive into the cave systems of Death Valley National Park, journey to Montezuma Well, search for shipwrecks in Buck Island, and explore Lake Mead.

lista.titulo: A Day on the Reef: Sipadan
lista.descripcion: On Malaysia's Sipadan Island, one of the most biodiverse places on the planet, is a great coral city that is home to millions of organisms who must navigate daily life.

Great Dying ║ 540 million years ago, the ancestors of modern organisms suddenly emerge in the Cambrian seas; evolution progresses and leaps onto land; but 250 million years ago, huge volcanic eruptions trigger the most severe mass extinctions in Earth's history.

lista.titulo: Secrets of the Brain • Cyborg - David Rose
lista.descripcion: Cyborg - David Rose ║ David Rose uses a new technology that doesn't work with his paralyzed body, but actually taps directly into his mind.
Music ║ Singing with a choir with many members that cannot talk, but they can sing.
Claudia Hughes ║ Thom tracks down real-life rubber girl Claudia Hughes, a contortionist whose extraordinary flexibility defies human physiology.
Tom Sietas ║ Freediver Tom Sietas holds his breath submerged for a death-defying 22 minutes.
Jerry Miculek ║ Thom heads to Louisiana to meet Jerry Miculek, the human machine gun who can fire a handgun faster than an automatic weapon.
Dean Karnazes ║ Thom Hunt heads to Nevada to meet Dean Karnazes, an ultramarathon runner who's taken endurance running to a level that defies human biology.

Snowball Earth ║ Throughout its history, Earth has continuously fluctuated between greenhouse and icehouse; an icehouse phase known as Snowball Earth was the most extreme period of cold the planet ever witnessed, with ice encasing Earth from the poles to the equator.
